scripts.text: ^FF0000Second!^009977 If you have a Caress that is refined or inserted with cards in your inventory which you don't want to reinforce, it could get destroyed or it's upgrades can get changed during the reinforcing process.
scripts.translation: 第二！如果背包里有你不想强化、已经精炼或插了卡片的印度尼西亚短剑，它们在强化过程中可能会损坏，或改变精炼等级。 ^FF0000^009977

scripts.text: If you don't want that to happen, put the refined Caress elsewhere before the reinforcing.^000000
scripts.translation: 不想发生这种事的话，强化前请先把已经精炼的短剑收好。 ^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000Third!^009977 Sometimes reinforcing fails. The weapon doesn't get destroyed every time you fail. However you should know that the weapon gets destroyed from time to time if you fail.^000000
scripts.translation: 第三！强化有时会失败。失败并不一定会损坏武器，但也可能导致武器损坏，这点你要记住。 ^FF0000^009977^000000

scripts.text: Whenever you want to reinforce the Caress, just bring me the Caress and 100,000 zeny.
You don't have all the materials. It's impossible to reinforce if you don't have them all. If you want to reinforce, bring 100,000 zeny and 1 Caress.
scripts.translation: 材料还没带齐，没法强化。想强化的话，请带上 100,000 Zeny 和 1 把印度尼西亚短剑。

scripts.text: Oh my~~ Almost succeeded... But failed. Sorry, sorry...
scripts.translation: 哎呀~~ 差一点就成功了...可惜还是失败了。抱歉抱歉...

scripts.text: Reinforcing the Caress has been successful. See you later.
scripts.translation: 印度尼西亚短剑强化成功了。下次再见。
